name: Run-Rate Frenzy
hook: Multiply last month by thirteen and declare yourself liquid before the SEC blinks
tagline: A sleep-deprived founder in a Patagonia vest feverishly rewires an S-1 financial curve as multiplier tokens skyrocket. Cashing out triggers a golden umbrella ejection into a pile of founder seed checks. Crashing slams an 80-page risk factor audit onto the desk that vaporizes the balance sheet.
